text:
Add a count of verdict findings per rule. Read the athena-sourced findings in records/jobs/*/verification.json for jobs that ended rejected. Count, per rule ID named in the finding (for example D43), the rejections in a rolling 36-hour window and in total. Show these counts in `athena status` beside the existing reading-refusal counts per rule in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs. When a rule is cited in 3 or more rejections in the window, print it with the IDs of those jobs, and say whether an open steward item names that rule. Acceptance: (1) A test built from fixtures shaped like the real verification records of jobs 20261112-180947-td6x, 20261030-013725-ap0q and 20261111-213010-8jgz counts D43 once per job and flags it. (2) Run `athena status --snapshot` on the real records and record the command and its output. The total for D43 must equal an independent grep count of verification files with a D43 finding on rejected jobs, and that command must be recorded too. (3) No other status line changes. (4) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass. (5) CHANGELOG.md has an entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Athena does not count how many rejections each verdict rule (such as D43) causes, so a misfiring rule keeps rejecting jobs and its open fix item is never raised
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: records/jobs/*/verification.json, crates/athena-core/src/status.rs., CHANGELOG.md
